entities.summary: Michael Clifton Burgess is an American physician and politician who represented Texas's 26th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 2003 to 2025. The district is anchored in Denton County, a suburban county north of Dallas and Fort Worth. He is a member of the Republican Party. Michael C. Burgess was a physicians & medical pioneers from Rochester (b. 1950-12-23, Rochester). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
